traits.name: Flyby
traits.text:
The mantidrake doesn’t provoke an opportunity attack when it
flies out of an enemy’s reach.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.text:
The mantidrake has advantage on Wisdom (Perception)
checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The mantidrake makes three attacks: one with its bite and
two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15
(2d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15
(2d8 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spikes
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16
(4d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text:
The mantidrake exhales its breath
based on its dragon head color. Each creature in the area affected
must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) damage on a
failed save, of half as much on a successful one.
